# cycloid_environment_type (Resource)

Manage organization-scoped environment types in Cycloid. Environment types categorize environments (e.g. `production`, `staging`) and carry a color used by the UI. Built-in defaults (`production`, `staging`, `development`) are flagged as `is_default` and cannot be renamed or deleted.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cycloid_environment_type" "qa" {
  name  = "QA"
  color = "#9b59b6"
}

resource "cycloid_environment_type" "preprod" {
  canonical = "preprod"
  name      = "Pre-production"
  color     = "#f39c12"
}

resource "cycloid_environment_type" "production_hardened" {
  name  = "Production"
  color = "#27ae60"

  label_selector = {
    enforcement = "hard"

    requirements = [
      {
        key      = "env-type"
        operator = "in"
        values   = ["production"]
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `color` (String) Color used to render this environment type in the UI. Free-form string up to 64 chars (hex codes such as `#27ae60` or named colors are accepted).

### Optional

- `canonical` (String) Stable identifier for the environment type. Lower-case alphanumerics with `-_.` separators, 1-100 chars. Inferred from `name` when omitted.
- `label_selector` (Attributes) Label selector constraining which stacks are offered in environments of this type. Omit to leave unconstrained. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--label_selector))
- `name` (String) Display name of the environment type. Either `name` or `canonical` must be set.
- `organization` (String) The organization canonical where the environment type lives. Defaults to the provider's `default_organization`.

### Read-Only

- `environments_count` (Number) Number of environments currently using this type.
- `id` (Number) Internal numeric ID assigned by the Cycloid API.
- `is_default` (Boolean) True for built-in environment types (`production`, `staging`, `development`). Built-ins cannot be renamed or deleted.

<a id="nestedatt--label_selector"></a>
### Nested Schema for `label_selector`

Required:

- `requirements` (Attributes List) Label requirements. A stack must satisfy ALL requirements to match (AND semantics). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--label_selector--requirements))

Optional:

- `enforcement` (String) Enforcement mode: `soft` only filters the stack list; `hard` also rejects creating a component from a non-matching stack. Defaults to `soft`.

<a id="nestedatt--label_selector--requirements"></a>
### Nested Schema for `label_selector.requirements`

Required:

- `key` (String) Label key to match against.
- `operator` (String) Matching operator: `eq` (exact single value) or `in` (at least one value matches).
- `values` (List of String) Values to match. For `eq` operator, exactly one value must be provided.
